aviation_incidents.headline: 紐幾內亞航空PX19航班出現右發動機火警指示 轉降達沃後146人撤離無人受傷
aviation_incidents.summary: 紐幾內亞航空PX19由香港飛往莫爾茲比港，波音767-300巡航時出現右發動機火警指示。機組關閉發動機後轉降菲律賓達沃，137名乘客與9名機組員經滑梯撤離，無人受傷；4條主輪胎洩氣，是否實際起火仍待調查。機場一度暫停其他航班起降，兩班原定抵達的國內航班取消，檢查後恢復運作。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Air Niugini Flight PX19 diverts to Davao after engine fire indication and all 146 evacuate uninjured
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Air Niugini Flight PX19, a Boeing 767-300 flying from Hong Kong to Port Moresby, diverted to Davao in the Philippines after a right-engine fire indication. The crew shut down the engine, and all 137 passengers and nine crew evacuated via slides without injury. Four main tires deflated, and whether a fire occurred remains under investigation. The airport temporarily suspended other flights; two inbound domestic flights were canceled, and operations resumed after inspections.

aviation_incidents.headline: 美國航空AA3230機組通報液壓異常返航鳳凰城 替代客機延誤抵達波特蘭
aviation_incidents.summary: 11月19日，美國航空A319執行AA3230航班，自鳳凰城飛往波特蘭，起飛後機組通報液壓異常並返航。落地後塔臺回報現場冒煙，客機經檢查後自行滑回停機坪。另一架A319接替航班，晚約4個半小時抵達；原機落地約40小時後恢復載客，異常原因仍待確認。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: American Airlines AA3230 returns to Phoenix after reported hydraulic problem, with replacement reaching Portland late
aviation_incidents.summary_en: On November 19, an American Airlines A319 operating Flight AA3230 returned to Phoenix after the crew reported a hydraulic problem following takeoff for Portland. The tower reported smoke at the scene after landing, and the aircraft taxied to the apron following an inspection. A replacement A319 reached Portland about four and a half hours late. The original aircraft resumed passenger service about 40 hours after landing; the cause remains unconfirmed.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 俄羅斯直升機疑似進入芬蘭領空 芬蘭邊防衛隊展開調查
taiwan_aviation.summary: 芬蘭國防部表示，11月21日當地中午，一架俄羅斯直升機疑似在洛維薩外海進入芬蘭領空，最遠約4.1公里；邊防衛隊正調查。芬蘭方面稱，事件可能與附近起火貨輪的救援或監控有關，直接關聯仍待釐清。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Finnish Border Guard investigates suspected Russian helicopter entry into Finnish airspace
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Finland's Defence Ministry said a Russian helicopter was suspected of entering Finnish airspace off Loviisa around local noon on November 21, potentially reaching as far as 4.1 kilometers inside. The Border Guard is investigating. Finnish authorities said the incident might be linked to rescue or monitoring efforts involving a nearby cargo ship that caught fire, but any direct connection remains under investigation.

international_aviation.headline: 美國航空以波音777-200ER全年每日自羅利—達拉姆直飛倫敦希斯洛 商務客與醫藥貨運支撐航線
international_aviation.summary: 羅利—達拉姆機場距夏洛特樞紐約209公里，美國航空仍以273座波音777-200ER全年每日直飛倫敦希斯洛。AA174每年載客約14萬人次、載客率至少75%；研究三角園區的商務旅客與醫藥貨運，加上自有機隊的低持有成本，支撐航線。
international_aviation.headline_en: American Airlines flies a Boeing 777-200ER daily year-round from Raleigh-Durham to London Heathrow, supported by business travelers and pharmaceutical cargo
international_aviation.summary_en: Raleigh-Durham is about 209 kilometers from American Airlines' Charlotte hub, yet the carrier flies a 273-seat Boeing 777-200ER daily year-round to London Heathrow. Flight AA174 carries about 140,000 passengers a year at a load factor of at least 75%. Business travelers from Research Triangle Park, pharmaceutical cargo and low ownership costs for the carrier's 777-200ER fleet support the route.

international_aviation.headline: Avelo航空2026/27冬季班表較去年同期少31條航線 6條國際線全數停飛
international_aviation.summary: Avelo航空2026/27冬季班表較去年同期少31條航線，其中25條國內線、6條國際線。北卡羅來納州威明頓機場失去9個目的地，受影響最大；國際線全數停飛，等於結束2024年開航的國際營運。Avelo已訂購50架Embraer E2客機，預計2028年起交付。
international_aviation.headline_en: Avelo Airlines' 2026/27 winter schedule has 31 fewer routes than a year earlier, with all international routes dropped
international_aviation.summary_en: Avelo Airlines' 2026/27 winter schedule has 31 fewer routes than the same period a year earlier: 25 domestic and six international. Wilmington International Airport in North Carolina loses service to nine destinations, the biggest reduction. All six international routes have been dropped, ending international service that began in 2024. Avelo has ordered 50 Embraer E2 aircraft, with deliveries expected from 2028.
